_comment: The PHP release the php bundle is built from, and the image it is built
in. php.net publishes no Linux binaries -- only source -- so this pins
the tarball we compile, by the digest php.net publishes for it at
A file of its own rather than a literal in build.yml, matching global.json
for the .NET SDK and go.mod for Go: a pin belongs somewhere greppable and
diffable. Nothing watches this one automatically -- there is no Dependabot
ecosystem for php.net source releases -- so it is bumped by hand, and the
digest is what makes that safe. scripts/check_digests.py verifies the
tarball pin alongside the ones in bundles.toml.
The builder is pinned for the same reason it is pinned everywhere else:
a floating alpine:3 moves the toolchain and libc the binary is compiled
against, so the artifact could change with no commit to explain it. The
digest is the multi-arch index, so one pin serves the amd64 and arm64
